evidence: Carries 'TX fees and policy' label and modifies src/txmempool.cpp and src/policy/fees/mempool_estimator.cpp.
rationale: Prevents mempool fee estimators from recording false confirmations and miscalculating coverage when a block mines an alternate witness variant of an unconfirmed transaction. Matching solely on txid caused CTxMemPool::removeForBlock to treat non-matching witness variants as mined, distorting fee stats and suppressing conflict notifications to subscribers.
